authorization: User: review the attached agent opinion, integrate and proceed.

storage.archival_policy: Small active diagnostic outputs on compute storage.

engineering_change: Replay CPU-canonical REAL on original CPU observation, then transfer observables unchanged to CUDA.

optimizer.acceptance: Same full-source-population two-bank hard loss decreases, guards pass and no flag count increases.
optimizer.failed_trial: Restore parameters; if no trial passes also restore Adam state.

endpoint_decision: Fresh two-bank32 primary PSD CDF improves >=10%, Q mass/wave/peak no worse by2%, flags do not increase. This is pilot advancement only, not original scientific acceptance.

measured_budget_basis.basis: Same724080 hard/STE rows as guard diagnostic plus backward sensitivity through32 candidate windows; no long training.

initialize_from: Saved accepted B checkpoint and original Adam state; training remains unchanged.
projection: Use exact two-pass independent-bank waveform-block gradient. In the diagonal learning-rate metric, remove positive waveform directional derivative from the Adam displacement. Recompute derivative after domain clipping and use original hard ADC trials.
motivation: First paired pilot: B PSD error -9.85%, waveform error +2.48%, ADC-rail flags increased by2 in each independent endpoint bank.
recovery_cost_accounting: Separate repeat of original setup, normalization and fixed endpoint; zero new optimizer updates.
archive_failure_handling: Operational results and arrays remain in active compute storage for analysis; no NAS probe or repair.
diagnostic_scope: One full-population gradient with a backward-only readout peak-selection correction; three hard trials and no committed update.
hypotheses: Adding the omitted peak-selection sensitivity can produce a direction whose native waveform risk actually decreases.
probe_scale: One full original Adam scale per tangent. Pure positive-wave descent has the same learning-rate-metric norm as the unprojected Adam displacement.
stop_rule: One gradient, one temporary Adam direction, three hard trials, restore weights. No additional steps or relaxed gates.
success_criterion: At least one hard trial decreases full global objective and actual waveform risk, passes unchanged Q/peak/flag guards; otherwise no new training.
gradient_rule: Hard ADC/argmax/crop values remain bitwise exact. Add derivative of softmax over32 search codes at one-ADC-code temperature, times detached candidate windows. Existing selected-value derivative retained once.
